# normalize recognizer result columns

recognizer <- recognizer %>%
  mutate(qseqid = str_replace(qseqid, "_#.*$", "")) %>%
  rename(
    db_id                       = `DB ID`,
    protein_description         = `Protein description`,
    db_description              = `DB description`,
    general_functional_category = `General functional category`,
    functional_category         = `Functional category`
  ) %>%
  rename_with(~ str_to_lower(.) %>% str_replace_all("\\s+", "_")) %>%
  select(
    qseqid,
    db_id,
    protein_description,
    db_description,
    general_functional_category,
    functional_category
  )



#load files
read_gene_score_file <- function(f, suffix_regex) {
  df <- readr::read_tsv(
    f,
    col_types = readr::cols(.default = readr::col_character()),
    na = c("", "NA", "NaN", "nan", "NULL")
  )

  # Ensure gene_id exists
  if (!("gene_id" %in% names(df))) {
    stop("No gene_id column in file: ", f)
  }

  # Convert every non-gene_id column to numeric (robust to occasional junk)
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(across(
      .cols = -gene_id,
      .fns  = ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.x))
    ))

  mag <- stringr::str_remove(basename(f), suffix_regex)
  mutate(df, MAG_ID = mag)
}

load_gene_dir <- function(dir, file_pattern = "\\.tsv$", suffix_regex) {
  files <- list.files(dir, pattern = file_pattern, full.names = TRUE)
  if (!length(files)) stop("No files found in: ", dir)

  bind_rows(lapply(files, read_gene_score_file, suffix_regex = suffix_regex)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(gene_id))
}

# per-test gene flags (has >=1 BH-sig site) over the universe
make_gene_flags <- function(sig_tbl, which_test, universe_tbl) {
  sig_ids <- sig_tbl %>%
    filter(test == which_test) %>%
    distinct(gene_id) %>%
    rename(qseqid = gene_id)

  universe_tbl %>%
    distinct(qseqid) %>%
    left_join(mutate(sig_ids, has_sig_site = TRUE), by = "qseqid") %>%
    mutate(has_sig_site = !is.na(has_sig_site)) %>%
    select(qseqid, has_sig_site)
}

gene_flags_paired  <- make_gene_flags(min_bh_sig, "paired_tTest",  annotations_universe)
gene_flags_fat     <- make_gene_flags(min_bh_sig, "fat_tTest",     annotations_universe)
gene_flags_control <- make_gene_flags(min_bh_sig, "control_tTest", annotations_universe)

#hypergeometric test-- Binary: does the gene have a BH corrected site that is still significant? 
# Mobilome exclusion: ONLY rows where recognizer functional_category == "Mobilome"
perform_hypergeo_binary <- function(
  annot_tbl,
  gene_flags_tbl,
  category_col,
  exclude_mobilome = FALSE
) {
  stopifnot(is.character(category_col), length(category_col) == 1)
  if (!("qseqid" %in% names(annot_tbl)))
    stop("annot_tbl must contain column 'qseqid'")
  if (!(category_col %in% names(annot_tbl)))
    stop(sprintf("annot_tbl must contain column '%s'", category_col))
  if (!all(c("qseqid", "has_sig_site") %in% names(gene_flags_tbl)))
    stop("gene_flags_tbl must contain columns 'qseqid' and 'has_sig_site'")

  annot_use <- annot_tbl

  if (exclude_mobilome) {
    
    if ("functional_category" %in% names(annot_use)) {
      annot_use <- annot_use %>%
        filter(is.na(functional_category) | functional_category != "Mobilome: prophages, transposons")
    }
  }

  pairs <- annot_use[, c("qseqid", category_col)]
  names(pairs) <- c("qseqid", "cat")
  pairs <- pairs[!is.na(pairs$cat), , drop = FALSE]
  pairs <- unique(pairs)

  pairs_flag <- left_join(
    tibble::as_tibble(pairs),
    tibble::as_tibble(gene_flags_tbl),
    by = "qseqid"
  )

  # Universe size = distinct genes that have a category assignment for this field
  N <- n_distinct(pairs_flag$qseqid)
  # Significant genes within that universe
  M <- n_distinct(pairs_flag$qseqid[pairs_flag$has_sig_site])

  if (N == 0L) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      category_col      = character(),
      category          = character(),
      total_count       = integer(),
      significant_count = integer(),
      N                 = integer(),
      M                 = integer(),
      hypergeo_p        = double(),
      hypergeo_p_adj    = double()
    ))
  }

  pairs_flag %>%
    group_by(cat) %>%
    summarise(
      total_count       = n_distinct(qseqid),
      significant_count = n_distinct(qseqid[has_sig_site]),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      N = N, M = M,
      hypergeo_p = stats::phyper(
        q = significant_count - 1,
        m = M,
        n = N - M,
        k = total_count,
        lower.tail = FALSE
      ),
      hypergeo_p_adj = stats::p.adjust(hypergeo_p, method = "BH")
    ) %>%
    arrange(hypergeo_p_adj) %>%
    rename(category = cat) %>%
    mutate(category_col = category_col, .before = 1)
}

# Category fields for BH-binary (recognizer + DRAM)
bh_category_fields <- c(
  "functional_category",
  "general_functional_category",
  "protein_description"
)

run_bh_binary <- function(gene_flags_tbl, exclude_mobilome) {
  bind_rows(lapply(bh_category_fields, function(cat_col) {
    perform_hypergeo_binary(
      annot_tbl        = annotations_universe,
      gene_flags_tbl   = gene_flags_tbl,
      category_col     = cat_col,
      exclude_mobilome = exclude_mobilome
    )
  }))
}

# Run enrichment: with Mobilome included vs excluded
hg_bh_paired      <- run_bh_binary(gene_flags_paired,  exclude_mobilome = FALSE)
hg_bh_paired_nom  <- run_bh_binary(gene_flags_paired,  exclude_mobilome = TRUE)

hg_bh_fat         <- run_bh_binary(gene_flags_fat,     exclude_mobilome = FALSE)
hg_bh_fat_nom     <- run_bh_binary(gene_flags_fat,     exclude_mobilome = TRUE)

hg_bh_control     <- run_bh_binary(gene_flags_control, exclude_mobilome = FALSE)
hg_bh_control_nom <- run_bh_binary(gene_flags_control, exclude_mobilome = TRUE)



###dot plots

TOP_N     <- 30
CAP_LOG10 <- 50

prep_dot_data <- function(hg_fat, hg_control, hg_paired, field,
                          top_n = TOP_N, cap_log10 = CAP_LOG10) {
  df_all <- bind_rows(
    hg_fat     %>% mutate(test = "fat"),
    hg_control %>% mutate(test = "control"),
    hg_paired  %>% mutate(test = "paired")
  ) %>%
    filter(category_col == field) %>%
    mutate(
      effect     = significant_count / pmax(total_count, 1L),
      nlog10_fdr = pmin(-log10(pmax(hypergeo_p_adj, .Machine$double.xmin)), cap_log10)
    )

  keep_cats <- df_all %>%
    group_by(test) %>%
    arrange(hypergeo_p_adj, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    distinct(category) %>%
    pull(category)

  df_all %>%
    filter(category %in% keep_cats) %>%
    group_by(category) %>%
    mutate(effect_max = max(effect, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(category = forcats::fct_reorder(category, effect_max)) %>%
    select(-effect_max)
}

make_dot_plot <- function(df_plot, field_label, title_suffix = "") {
  bg_df <- df_plot %>% mutate(bg_rate = M / N) %>% distinct(test, bg_rate)

  ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = effect, y = category)) +
    geom_vline(
      data = bg_df,
      aes(xintercept = bg_rate, color = test),
      linetype = 2, show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_point(aes(color = test, size = nlog10_fdr), alpha = 0.9) +
    geom_point(
      data = filter(df_plot, hypergeo_p_adj < 0.05),
      shape = 21, fill = NA, color = "black", stroke = 0.7,
      aes(size = nlog10_fdr)
    ) +
    scale_size_continuous(name = expression(-log[10]~FDR)) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(fat = "#FF69B4", control = "#1F77B4", paired = "#2CA02C"),
      name = "Test"
    ) +
    labs(
      title    = paste0(field_label, " enrichment across tests", title_suffix),
      subtitle = "Effect size = significant_count / total_count; size = -log10(FDR); dashed = background M/N",
      x        = "Effect size (proportion with ≥1 BH-sig gene)",
      y        = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "right",
                   panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
}

category_fields <- bh_category_fields

plots <- list(with_mobilome = list(), no_mobilome = list())

for (fld in category_fields) {
  df_w  <- prep_dot_data(hg_bh_fat,     hg_bh_control,     hg_bh_paired,     fld)
  df_wo <- prep_dot_data(hg_bh_fat_nom, hg_bh_control_nom, hg_bh_paired_nom, fld)

  plots$with_mobilome[[fld]] <- make_dot_plot(df_w,  fld, " (Mobilome included)")
  plots$no_mobilome[[fld]]   <- make_dot_plot(df_wo, fld, " (Mobilome excluded)")
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) BH-binary hypergeometric enrichment
#    CHANGE: define "significant genes" as FAT & PAIRED but NOT CONTROL

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

make_gene_flags <- function(sig_tbl, which_test, universe_tbl) {
  sig_ids <- sig_tbl %>%
    filter(test == which_test) %>%
    distinct(gene_id) %>%
    rename(qseqid = gene_id)

  universe_tbl %>%
    distinct(qseqid) %>%
    left_join(mutate(sig_ids, has_sig_site = TRUE), by = "qseqid") %>%
    mutate(has_sig_site = !is.na(has_sig_site)) %>%
    select(qseqid, has_sig_site)
}


gene_flags_paired  <- make_gene_flags(min_bh_sig, "paired_tTest",  annotations_universe) %>%
  rename(sig_paired = has_sig_site)

gene_flags_fat     <- make_gene_flags(min_bh_sig, "fat_tTest",     annotations_universe) %>%
  rename(sig_fat = has_sig_site)

gene_flags_control <- make_gene_flags(min_bh_sig, "control_tTest", annotations_universe) %>%
  rename(sig_control = has_sig_site)

# --- NEW: combo definition (fat & paired & !control) ---
gene_flags_combo <- gene_flags_fat %>%
  left_join(gene_flags_paired,  by = "qseqid") %>%
  left_join(gene_flags_control, by = "qseqid") %>%
  mutate(
    sig_fat     = coalesce(sig_fat,     FALSE),
    sig_paired  = coalesce(sig_paired,  FALSE),
    sig_control = coalesce(sig_control, FALSE),
    has_sig_site = sig_fat & sig_paired & !sig_control
  ) %>%
  select(qseqid, has_sig_site)

message(
  "Combo sig genes (fat & paired & !control): ",
  sum(gene_flags_combo$has_sig_site, na.rm = TRUE),
  " / universe genes: ",
  nrow(gene_flags_combo)
)


perform_hypergeo_binary <- function(
  annot_tbl,
  gene_flags_tbl,
  category_col,
  exclude_mobilome = FALSE
) {
  stopifnot(is.character(category_col), length(category_col) == 1)

    stop("gene_flags_tbl must contain columns 'qseqid' and 'has_sig_site'")

  annot_use <- annot_tbl

  if (exclude_mobilome) {
    # EXACTLY as in your working script (not "Mobilome" only)
    if ("functional_category" %in% names(annot_use)) {
      annot_use <- annot_use %>%
        filter(is.na(functional_category) |
                        functional_category != "Mobilome: prophages, transposons")
    }
  }

  pairs <- annot_use[, c("qseqid", category_col)]
  names(pairs) <- c("qseqid", "cat")
  pairs <- pairs[!is.na(pairs$cat), , drop = FALSE]
  pairs <- unique(pairs)

  pairs_flag <- left_join(
    tibble::as_tibble(pairs),
    tibble::as_tibble(gene_flags_tbl),
    by = "qseqid"
  )

  # Universe size = distinct genes that have a category assignment for this field
  N <- n_distinct(pairs_flag$qseqid)
  # Significant genes within that universe

  if (N == 0L) {

    ))
  }

  pairs_flag %>%

      total_count       = n_distinct(qseqid),
      significant_count = n_distinct(qseqid[has_sig_site]),
